proves: A moving dot and three generated Web Audio notes, on the game clock.
html:
<style>html,body{margin:0;overflow:hidden;background:#142238}canvas{display:block;width:100vw;height:100vh}</style><canvas></canvas><script>
const canvas = document.querySelector('canvas');
canvas.width = Math.round(innerWidth * devicePixelRatio);
canvas.height = Math.round(innerHeight * devicePixelRatio);
const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
const audio = new AudioContext();
const note = audio.createBuffer(1, 4800, 48000);
const samples = note.getChannelData(0);
for (let i = 0; i < samples.length; i++) samples[i] = Math.sin(i / 48000 * 2 * Math.PI * 440) * 0.4 * (1 - i / samples.length);
window.startShot = () => {
  for (const ms of [500, 1000, 1500]) setTimeout(() => {
    const sound = audio.createBufferSource();
    sound.buffer = note;
    sound.connect(audio.destination);
    sound.start();
  }, ms);
};
let tick = 0;
function frame() {
  tick++;
  const w = canvas.width, h = canvas.height;
  ctx.fillStyle = '#142238'; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#6ee7b7'; ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(w * (0.2 + 0.6 * (tick % 120) / 120), h / 2, h / 12, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
  requestAnimationFrame(frame);
}
requestAnimationFrame(frame);
</script>
